map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Clermont, Franklin and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Clermont (as of 2026-10-19 14:40): mail returned 5,096 (state 4,160); early in person 6,677 (state 5,997). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-18 16:07): early in person 14,380 (state 14,324). Franklin (as of 2026-10-19 00:12): ballots sent 77,678 (state 76,739). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-19 07:32): mail returned 3,093 (state 3,091).
